info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v5-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback API facilitates the retrieval of feedback related to job applications submitted through the careers portal. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can obtain insights into candidate submissions, allowing for improved recruitment strategies and applicant experience. This API is typically utilized by HR teams, hiring managers, and recruitment platforms to analyze and respond to candidate feedback effectively. Accessing this data supports the optimization of application processes and enhances overall engagement with potential employees.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the feedback associated with the applications. Utilize this to gain insights into user experiences and areas for improvement.
